name: Vince McMahon Reaction
aka: Vince McMahon Reaction With Glowing Eyes
look: Four stacked frames of WWE's Vince McMahon in a light suit, seated at a wrestling event, beside a blank white column for captions. He goes from mildly intrigued to wide-eyed, then gasping with his head thrown back, and finally a red-tinted face with glowing white eyes.
use: An escalating reaction. Each caption on the left gets more impressive, exciting or outrageous, and the amazement grows to match, ending with the glowing-eyed explosion for the best or most absurd one.
slots: the mind-blowing final step (fourth box, glowing eyes)
examples: Free pizza at work and the meeting is cancelled
A long weekend and it doesn't rain
describe: wrestling boss getting more and more excited
old man in a suit reacting with growing shock
guy's eyes start glowing red in the last panel
vince mcmahon amazed reaction in four panels
businessman losing his mind in his seat at a wrestling show
origin: Frames of WWE's Vince McMahon reacting from his seat at a wrestling event, with the last frame edited to glow red.
